prediction_instant.citation: T = the charity's recorded 'AIS Due Date' for period Y minus 90 days. The due date is fixed by announced policy (ACNC AIS due-dates page: six months after the period end, with the Commissioner's standing extension to the following 31 January for standard 1 July-30 June periods; measured in-file: period ends 30/06/2023 carry due 31/01/2024, period ends 31/12/2024 carry due 30/06/2025). Every shipped feature is a prior-period AIS fact whose recorded receipt is <= T by construction.
